items_all.title: 404 Media 分析 PHP2Shell 事件如何改变 AI 时代的攻防格局
items_all.summary: 404 Media 的 Jason Koebler 梳理近一个月安全专家对 AI 挖洞能力引发的"Black October"恐慌。Wiz、Calif 和 OpenAI 的研究者用 AI 发现了 PHP 的 PHP2Shell 漏洞，Cloudflare CEO 称公开公告前 10 小时已见数千次利用尝试，公告后 2 小时内增至数十万，目前达数百万级。
items_all.title_original: AI Is Changing Everything About Hacking. No One Knows What Happens Next
items_all.title_en: AI Is Changing Everything About Hacking. No One Knows What Happens Next
items_all.title_zh: 404 Media 分析 PHP2Shell 事件如何改变 AI 时代的攻防格局
items_all.title_bilingual: 404 Media 分析 PHP2Shell 事件如何改变 AI 时代的攻防格局 / AI Is Changing Everything About Hacking. No One Knows What Happens Next

en.summary: 404 Media’s Jason Koebler rounds up a month of security experts’ alarm over a “Black October” driven by AI’s vulnerability-hunting capabilities. Researchers at Wiz, Calif, and OpenAI used AI to discover PHP’s PHP2Shell vulnerability. Cloudflare’s CEO said thousands of exploitation attempts were seen 10 hours before the public disclosure, hundreds of thousands within 2 hours after it, and millions by now.

items_all.title_en: ARTEX in the Wild: Storm-0940 Expands Targeting of IT and Software Vendors

items_all.title: Symantec 披露“Skynet 模式”AI 智能体劫持无防护大语言模型发起自持续网络攻击
items_all.summary: Symantec 研究人员通过蜜罐截获一个把大语言模型嵌入核心的攻击智能体，它会劫持互联网上无防护的模型端点，自主扫描目标、利用服务器漏洞、窃取数据库凭据并安装挖矿程序，最多连续执行 100,000 步，算力费用由被劫持模型的主人承担。
items_all.title_original: An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks
items_all.title_en: An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks
items_all.title_zh: Symantec 披露“Skynet 模式”AI 智能体劫持无防护大语言模型发起自持续网络攻击
items_all.title_bilingual: Symantec 披露“Skynet 模式”AI 智能体劫持无防护大语言模型发起自持续网络攻击 / An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks

en.summary: Symantec researchers used a honeypot to intercept an attack agent with an LLM at its core. It hijacks unprotected model endpoints across the internet, autonomously scans targets, exploits server vulnerabilities, steals database credentials, and installs crypto miners, running up to 100,000 consecutive steps—with the compute bill footed by the owners of the hijacked models.

items_all.title: Kling 4.0 现已上线 OnSolo
items_all.summary: 可灵（Kling）宣布 Kling 4.0 已在 OnSolo 上线。该模型支持单次生成 30 秒原生视频，快速动作和大运镜下保持稳定，立体声配更准的口型同步，并提供 21:9 宽屏，单个任务可叠加最多 15 个参考图和 10 个关键帧以保持角色、镜头与剧情一致。
items_all.title_original: Kling 4.0 is now live on OnSolo. #Kling4 #KlingAI
items_all.title_en: Kling 4.0 is now live on OnSolo. #Kling4 #KlingAI
items_all.title_zh: Kling 4.0 现已上线 OnSolo
items_all.title_bilingual: Kling 4.0 现已上线 OnSolo / Kling 4.0 is now live on OnSolo. #Kling4 #KlingAI

en.summary: Kling has announced that Kling 4.0 is now live on OnSolo. The model can generate 30-second native video in a single pass, stays stable through fast action and large camera moves, offers stereo audio with more accurate lip sync, and supports a 21:9 widescreen format. A single task can stack up to 15 reference images and 10 keyframes to keep characters, shots and storyline consistent.

items_all.summary: WSJ 报道，马斯克希望以 AI 为核心将估值约 $2T 的 SpaceX 与约 $1.5T 的 Tesla 合并。SpaceX 的 AI 业务已成其最大业务，Q3 营收 $7.56B（一年前仅 $813M），季度 $19.6B 资本开支中超过 $16.4B 投向 AI，推动 SpaceX 实现季度利润 $4.4B（上年同期亏损 $1.05B）。

en.summary: WSJ reports that Musk wants to merge SpaceX, valued at about $2T, with Tesla, valued at about $1.5T, with AI at the core. SpaceX’s AI business has become its largest business: Q3 revenue was $7.56B, up from just $813M a year earlier, and more than $16.4B of its $19.6B quarterly capex went to AI, helping SpaceX post a $4.4B quarterly profit, compared with a $1.05B loss a year earlier.

items_all.title: Bloomberg 报道 DeepSeek 新一轮融资约 150 亿美元
items_all.summary: 据 Bloomberg，DeepSeek 最新一轮融资约 150 亿美元，为中国最大规模私募融资之一。谈判期间融资目标至少两次上调，从约 75 亿美元提高到 120 亿美元；CATL 和腾讯是最大投资方之一，CATL 据报出资约 15 亿美元。投前估值约 748 亿美元，加上 6 月完成的首轮超 75 亿美元，DeepSeek 约 6 个月内共募资约 225 亿美元。

en.summary: Bloomberg reports that DeepSeek’s latest funding round is about $15 billion, one of China’s largest private financings. The fundraising target was raised at least twice during negotiations, from about $7.5 billion to $12 billion; CATL and Tencent are among the largest investors, with CATL reportedly contributing about $1.5 billion. The pre-money valuation is about $74.8 billion. Including a first round of more than $7.5 billion completed in June, DeepSeek has raised about $22.5 billion in roughly six months.

en.summary: The author walks through the full arc of two PHP remote code execution vulnerabilities that started at a perfect CVSS score (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, together known as PHP2Shell) — from the early leak and the demo video that surfaced, to government websites in multiple countries going offline as a precaution, and finally the patch going live at 10 p.m. on the 21st. The piece also notes that the two vulnerabilities were found with assistance from GPT-5.6 Sol, and that OpenAI released a detection skill.

en.summary: OpenAI is offering a Codex skill for a critical PHP vulnerability, directing users to run the github.com/openai/php2shell-checker repository to check whether their sites are affected. The background: under its Patch the Planet initiative, OpenAI models helped researchers find a critical PHP flaw; the fix required major changes to the PHP engine and was disclosed after roughly two months of coordination. Sites using PHP can upgrade their versions and apply mitigations from security vendors.

items_all.title: AI 搜索是怎么做出来的
items_all.summary: 你问AI明天天气，它几秒就给出答案和出处，背后却是模型拆检索词、搜索引擎筛结果，再把信息送回模型判断；复杂任务还要由 Agent 连续搜好几轮。那么 Agent 为什么“会联网”、如何选对搜索能力？作者带你拆开AI搜索的完整链路：理解查询、辨别信源、补充实时数据、压低延迟，以及 API、MCP、Skill 三种接入方式。

en.title: How AI search is built
en.summary: Ask an AI about tomorrow's weather and it returns an answer with sources in seconds—but behind that, the model breaks the query into search terms, the search engine filters results, and the information goes back to the model to judge; complex tasks require an Agent to run several search rounds in a row. So why can Agents "go online," and how do you choose the right search capability? The author breaks down the full AI search pipeline: understanding the query, vetting sources, adding real-time data, keeping latency low, and the three integration approaches—API, MCP, and Skill.

en.title: One title, two third-place finishes! These friends who met at an AI bootcamp took their projects onto the Anker hackathon podium
en.summary: Learned a pile of AI tools but still haven't shipped anything real? Several students from the WaytoAGI training camp have an answer: strangers in class who teamed up for Anker's first hackathon, built products in 24 hours around real problems like home energy storage and office companionship, and came away with one first place and two second places. This article chronicles how they got noticed through their work, found reliable teammates, and turned industry experience into products.

items_all.title: 目前AI已达高度先进阶段：前沿模型（如Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-6等）在科学、数学、编程多数基准上超越人类专家，智能体可独立处理数小时复杂任务，AI正加速自身研发（部分实验室AI主导超25%工作）。SI尚未完全实现，但进展极快，有观点认为奇点已开始，AGI或在近1-2年内出现。 对人类用处：大幅加速科研创新（数学证明、药物发现）、提升生产力、辅助医疗与教育、推动机器人落地，创造巨大经济价值，同时也带来就业与安全挑战。

items_all_raw.title: 目前AI已达高度先进阶段：前沿模型（如Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-6等）在科学、数学、编程多数基准上超越人类专家，智能体可独立处理数小时复杂任务，AI正加速自身研发（部分实验室AI主导超25%工作）。SI尚未完全实现，但进展极快，有观点认为奇点已开始，AGI或在近1-2年内出现。 对人类用处：大幅加速科研创新（数学证明、药物发现）、提升生产力、辅助医疗与教育、推动机器人落地，创造巨大经济价值，同时也带来就业与安全挑战。

items_all_raw.title: AI 搜索是怎么做出来的
items_all_raw.summary: 你问AI明天天气，它几秒就给出答案和出处，背后却是模型拆检索词、搜索引擎筛结果，再把信息送回模型判断；复杂任务还要由 Agent 连续搜好几轮。那么 Agent 为什么“会联网”、如何选对搜索能力？作者带你拆开AI搜索的完整链路：理解查询、辨别信源、补充实时数据、压低延迟，以及 API、MCP、Skill 三种接入方式。
